what: From integrate-docs: release paths use commands v2 lacks. install.sh:305 runs `blaze toolchain`; .github/workflows/promote.yaml:127 and install.yaml:79 run `blaze new` (crates/blaze-new exists but v2 CLI has no `new`). A v2 release fails both checks (docs/release.md, docs/install.md say so). Also: docs/contributing.md and .github/CONTRIBUTING.md tell contributors `cargo build`/`cargo test` blaze, against blaze-builds-blaze; left as is since a clone has no blaze to bootstrap with. And blaze-cargo/Cargo.toml:80 depends on blaze-web with no use in code; v2 has no `blaze ui` (docs/web.md marked record; ci lane owns the page).
